each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

However, the line of the same color is missing at intersections with another block (likely the 7 block). The horizontal line at row 5 extends, but there's a zero at column 13 where it intersects. I need to clarify why there's a gap there. 

The color 8 should fill row 5 except for column 13, which seems to be due to overlapping with the color 7 block that affects this area.**Understanding intersection conflicts**

When reviewing column 13, I notice that rows 0-4 and 6-10 show 7, while row 5 is blank, and rows 11-12 and 13-16 have 7 as well. This means that there’s a full line of 7 in column 13.
